headline: Regulatory Hurdles Block Malacas Gas Power Plant Amid Northern Peru Energy Crunch
summary: Peru's Malacas thermal power station is unable to generate electricity with Piura natural gas due to regulatory barriers, keeping northern power prices elevated compared to Lima and Ica.
why: Power tariff disparity and gas dispatch bottlenecks directly raise operating costs for mining and industrial producers in northern Peru.

impacts.name: Peruvian Energy Sector
impacts.why: Regulatory limits prevent gas-fired generation in northern Peru, driving up power costs.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
